sn46.30:1.1: setakaṁ nāma → setakannāma (sya-all) | setakaṁ → sedakaṁ (bj: sī.pævi, sī.pavi)
sn46.30:1.2: udāyī → udāyi (sya-all) | ekamantaṁ → ekamantaṁ nisīdi ekamantaṁ (sya-all)
sn46.30:2.2: bahukatañca → bahukataṁ ca (bj); bahukārāpi (sya-all) | pemañca → pemaṁ ca (bj) | hirī → hiri (bj, sya-all) | ca → bahukārāpi (bj: syā)
sn46.30:2.3: ahañhi → ahaṁ hi (bj) | agārikabhūto → āgārikabhūto (sya-all) | dhammena → dhamme (cck: ?)
sn46.30:2.4: khvāhaṁ → khvāhaṁ bhante (bj) | pabbajito → pabbajiṁ (bj, sya-all) | hiriṁ → gāravo ca hiri ca (bj: sī.pævi, sī.pavi) | pabbajiṁ → pabbajito (bj: machasaṁ, sīmu)
sn46.30:3.1: imesaṁ pañcupādānakkhandhānaṁ → imesu pañcasu upādānakkhandhesu (bj) | samparivattento → samparivattanto (sya-all) | upādānakkhandhesu → imesaṁ pañcupādānakkhandhānaṁ (bj: machasaṁ, syā)
sn46.30:3.2: abhisamito → abhisameto (sya-all) | abhisamito → abhisameto (bj: sī.pævi, sī.pavi, syā) | paṭiladdho → maggo ca me paṭiladdho (bj: machasaṁ, syā)
